description: A program branches on json.kind with match.
program: (let [doc "{\"author\": {\"name\": \"Ada\"}, \"license\": \"MIT\"}" shape (fn [field] (match (json.kind doc [field]) String (json.get doc [field]) Object (json.get doc [field "name"]) _ none))] [(shape "author") (shape "license") (shape "bugs")])
